disclaimer_override.heading: A note on safety and sources
paras: Edibility and medicinal information on this page is for educational reference only. Always verify identification with multiple authoritative sources before consuming any wild plant or fungi. Never rely on any single source, including this page, as your sole basis for a consumption decision. Identification and content may be AI-assisted. Human-created and/or reviewed content is indicated where shown. This page is an educational resource, not a safety-certified identification system.
